summary: Phase 14 (P1): Real TradeMe connector behind the existing connect/sync endpoints. Implemented services/integrations/trademe.py with OAuth 1.0a (request token -> authorize URL -> verifier callback via POST /api/integrations/{platform}/oauth/callback), Fernet-encrypted tokens at rest (CONNECTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY; never exposed by GET /integrations), and live sync that creates PENDING approval-gated reduce_price suggestions from TradeMe listing anchors + search fallback. The adapter is staged: without TRADEME_CONSUMER_KEY/SECRET the legacy simulated toggle/sync is preserved so the preview and isolation suites keep passing. Network calls run via asyncio.to_thread and are patchable in tests. Frontend IntegrationHub opens the authorize URL and handles the OAuth callback redirect. Verified with 6 new tests (full local suite 58 passed, 2 skipped) plus a live uvicorn smoke test (5 connectors seeded, no token leakage, legacy connect/sync intact, callback 404 when unconfigured).
passed_tests: CONNECTORS: 5 platforms seeded; tokens/config never exposed by GET /integrations
LEGACY: unconfigured TradeMe connect toggles connected, sync returns simulated note, disconnect works, sync blocked when disconnected, oauth callback -> 404
OAUTH: connect returns authorization_required + authorize URL; stored OAuth state encrypted at rest
OAUTH: mismatched verifier token -> 400; correct verifier -> connected with tokens encrypted at rest and sync_enabled=true
SYNC: live sync queues exactly one pending reduce_price suggestion from a TradeMe anchor
SYNC: no listing mutation until the user approves (control layer apply changes price to the anchor)
SYNC: idempotent re-sync keeps one pending suggestion (fresh id, no duplicates)
SYNC: search fallback used when no exact TradeMe listing match; anchor respected
SYNC: anchor >= 95% of current price -> no suggestion (threshold skip)
HTTP SMOKE: integrations list without token leakage; legacy connect/sync; unconfigured callback -> 404
